newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA SEBI DEFERS DECISION ON CARRY-FORWARD.
newsitem.headline: INDIA SEBI DEFERS DECISION ON CARRY-FORWARD.

text.p: The board of India's capital market regulator could not consider a proposal to modify the system of carry-forward trades, its chief said on Tuesday.
"The board did not consider the carry-forward issue at today's meet," D.R. Mehta, chairman of the Securities and Exchange Board of India told a news conference.
The board had been widely expected to announce a modified system of carry-forward trade which would ease restriction on transactions and increase funding limits.
"This issue will be taken up at the board's meeting at Madras on September 5," Mehta said.
